Unclear Medi fragments not scored: 01:58 'شو كما ما مرا', 04:42 'آه هلا قلبك', 10:48 'haketni bare', 1:00:10 'Zakarsaf', 58:00 'maqtarakhar'. 41:58 'بوتنا' for خططنا is probably a transcription of 5u66atna (Amal said Perfect; chat 5u66atna). 47:37 'تصوري' vs chat tetsawwari - Amal said ممتاز so not filed. 1:00:18 zakaratni for 'she remembered me' - Amal accepted with optional et-, not filed. coverage.r2: Whole file read in order. Latin-transliterated stretches (transcriber Latin, q for k): 06:05-13:00 partial, 18:14-24:11, 48:51-56:04, 57:52-1:05:45. Not filed (S4 pronunciation): ما تفي for مطفي (02:04), عطلوا for قاتلوا (26:47, dropped ق), كسا for كسر (27:52/28:13), اقرب for أغلب (17:38), شهر for شعر (44:12, she did call it out as 'month'), maqsudin for maksooreen (19:12), هلات إلى 12 for talaat illa tult (05:05, chat has it), بوتنا for 5u66atna (41:58), Asmaa vowel length (1:03:08). Self-fixes not filed: الأمبارح->امبارح (05:52/06:01), كان في محل->كنت (03:17), 'خروف is pig'->lamb (04:00, English meta), كسروا->انكسروا (14:57/15:06), اكسرو->ما تكسرو (17:13), meeting->ijtema (24:11), شعرها->شعرك (44:12/44:18), sawarti->sawarit (55:46). Ambiguous: 16:18 بتكسري vs her تكسري (chat has btekser) not filed. Speaker labels looked consistent; chat lines lag 30-120 s as expected.

r3_note: D6 and D7 are two different errors that the matcher glued together: D6's r1 half (Aqlab min -> no min, A2 idafa) and D7 (snenha -> snanha, vocab tier 1). r2's 0915-19 is the same row as D7, so D6 is settled as the grammar row and D7 as the vocab row; do not count them as one. Chat policy used here: every one of Amal's typed model lines that differs from what he said is labelled kind A with signal chat-fix, with confidence lowered to low when her voice had approved (Perfect / Nice / Mm-hmm) - the merger may want to keep those apart from voice fixes. The ASR in this lesson drops a final -h even in Amal's own lines (12:45 ما تكسري for ma tekserih), writes kasaro/kasaru both as كسروا, and its Latin stretches (livil, lavit, yaref) are rough, so several D-rows rest on her chat lines. Nothing added: every other slip I saw (راي/رأيي, تغير/تغيرت, Program masculine, kam sawar, Zakarini, ma id zakar, aja min/على, نفس الـ امبارح, تصوريني/صوريني, bitsawri/بتتصوري) reads as ground both readers would have covered.
